body: U+0023# Accessibility fixes: spec approved, sweep run startedU+000AU+000AU+002A*Spec.** `docs/specs/a11y-fixes.md` (bug pathway, git-ignored), with its decisions file.U+000AU+002D 15 Steps, 18 assumptions, 0 open questions.U+000AU+002D Reproduction: `docs/specs/a11y-fixes.repro/`. 51 tests, of which 50 fail today on their symptom; the 51st passes only in the probe, because it already holds the state libraries.U+000AU+002D The spec reviewer raised 13 issues, all fixed. The owner approved the written spec.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Owner decisions:**U+000AU+002D **Tap size.** 48 dp for every app control, with the painted look unchanged and the layout growing only by the minimum.U+000AU+002D **Barriers.** Flutter's "Dismiss" barriers are accepted.U+000AU+002D **Inert rule.** A seventh rule, `inert-button`, is added.U+000AU+002D **Extras.** Fix things read twice, the month picker, and missing names.U+000AU+002D **Dropped.** The c6 check is dropped for Android.U+000AU+002D **Clock.** The device-clock reads stay a recorded limitation.U+000AU+002D **PRs.** Two: the sweep first, then the app PR stacked on it.U+000AU+002D **Pre-mortem.** All four failure modes are guarded.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Key facts found while grounding:**U+000AU+002D The phone's "27 dp tabs" are Android clipping node bounds at y=2195. The app draws to 2280 with a bottom inset of 0. So the report's "no insets" blind spot was wrong.U+000AU+002D Flutter clips semantics rects to what is visible. The small-target skip must therefore compare a node's rect with its render object's semantic bounds; edges can't tell a clipped node from one shown whole.U+000AU+002D The video scrubber is already a disabled slider with no tap in code; the phone's clickable View is left to the post-merge phone check.U+000AU+002D At phone width, 48 dp format buttons need 480 dp against about 290 dp of bar, so More formats is reached by scrolling.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Build.** Two mitosis runs, because both MSPs write the baselines and a shared file fuses them into one Lane.U+000AU+002D **Sweep run:** 4 Lanes, run dir `~/.mitosis/runs/field-notes/2026-09-25-a11y-fixes-sweep`, started from `feat/composer-editor-core`. The local branch was fast-forwarded to ae5128d first.U+000AU+002D **App run:** 11 Lanes. It starts from the sweep MSP's branch after the session maps every added baseline line to an app Step.
